basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Ground Maintenance Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 has 1 Ground Maintenance Staff post. The post is filled through an outsourcing agency for 1 year, with an extension based on performance. It pays ₹25,718/- (Semi-Skilled) consolidated per month. Candidates need at least a 10th pass and 1 year of relevant experience in ground maintenance at any sports academy. The age limit is up to 30 years from the last date of advertisement, which is 23 October 2026. The notice does not mention how or where to apply.
